items_window_check.name: items_window_check

items_kind_check.name: items_kind_check

customer_profiles_preferences_check.name: customer_profiles_preferences_check
customer_profiles_preferences_check.value:
jsonb_typeof("customer_profiles"."preferences") = 'object'
      and "customer_profiles"."preferences" ?& array['theme','bookingReminders']
      and ("customer_profiles"."preferences" - 'theme' - 'bookingReminders') = '{}'::jsonb
      and jsonb_typeof("customer_profiles"."preferences"->'theme') = 'string'
      and "customer_profiles"."preferences"->>'theme' in ('system','light','dark')
      and jsonb_typeof("customer_profiles"."preferences"->'bookingReminders') = 'boolean'

deals_value_check.name: deals_value_check

payments_provider_check.name: payments_provider_check
payments_provider_check.value: length(btrim("payments"."provider")) > 0 and length(btrim("payments"."provider_account_ref")) > 0 and ("payments"."provider_payment_id" is null or length(btrim("payments"."provider_payment_id")) > 0)
